issue_context.title: Missing "View" button for PDFs
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**

The "View" button is missing for PDF binaries.

Screenshot shows the expected button:

![Screenshot n8n binary view](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/assets/13757952/63049b94-6523-4d3a-a49b-45337b6d0370)

**To Reproduce**

1. Get a PDF as binary (Read File Node, Http Node, ...)
2. Try to view it, only the "Download" button will be available

**Expected behavior**

The possibility to view PDF binaries directly without downloading them.

**Additional context**

First guess: The fileType for PDFs is missing in the Array in [`RunData.vue:1323`](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/f4d8c9eed5c03b4056bf591ec5c6ab8809dc7ea0/packages/editor-ui/src/components/RunData.vue#L1323)
comments:
Hey @marzn,

Thanks for the report 🙌🏻 , We have put in a fix for this which will be merged and released once reviewed.

review_comments: should we use `document` instead of `pdf` here? are there any other document types that browsers can easily render via the `<embed>` tag, that are also relevant to us?
`text/html` could be rendered in `<embed>`, but that might be a security risk, as the html file could be used for arbitrary code execution.
I can see more documents being needed.. but as long as users can download them, it's fine as is. or until a user requests it
